name: Imolicious
source:
After the death of their parents, Wataru Akimiya and his younger sister Kanako starting to live together. Still being students, it's really tough for them, but they manage to have a pretty normal life. Summer is near and so Watarus lust for his sister is growing. Day after day it's getting harder for Wataru to hold back ...
Will he be able to suppress his forbidden feelings for his sister, or will he break a taboo?
translation:
父母去世后，秋宫涉与妹妹加奈子开始共同生活。两人还是学生，日子十分艰难，却设法过着相当普通的生活。夏天临近，涉对妹妹的欲望逐渐增长，一天天变得越来越难以压抑……

他能抑制对妹妹的禁忌感情，还是会打破这道禁忌？
